description: Yearly dog tax per Swiss commune from official sources where a canton has a uniform rate or publishes every commune: Vaud (cantonal CHF 100 plus each commune's tax), Lucerne and Aargau (CHF 120 everywhere), Basel-Stadt (CHF 160 / 150 / 120, each further dog double), Basel-Landschaft (each commune). With commune (name or BFS number): that commune; without: all covered communes. Geneva and other cantons are not covered.

commune.description: commune name or BFS number, optional

name: dog_tax
